name: Optic Grid
pitch: A 30-tile photographic matrix governed by in-flight optical filters, dynamic glass scale gauges, and seamless GSAP Flip layout morphing.

lifecycle.idle: High-density editorial contact grid resting in pristine contrast
lifecycle.discovery: Selecting a layout or scale triggers synchronized parabolic FLIP motion
lifecycle.buildUp: In-flight optical filters bloom, invert, or shift chromatic values mid-transit
lifecycle.peak: Images land gracefully into new asymmetric spans with cushioned liquid easing
lifecycle.recovery: Optical filters dissolve back to neutral baseline as final positions lock
